cards.title: Act Like You Belong
cards.instruction: You do not understand what is happening. Copy the confidence around you and never admit confusion.

cards.title: Merciful Lie
cards.instruction: Choose a truth your character believes would hurt someone. Keep it from them, even as honesty becomes harder.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Naturally. The usual arrangement. The magazine hasn't rejected your poem. They think it deserves its own booklet.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: They returned it. If even you think it's hopeless, I'll stop writing.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Exactly how we always do it. That's why they returned it. They can't give it enough space.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Will you write that on the cover? With your name?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Gladly. 'A voice that deserves more space.' Print my name large enough for the editor to see.

mechanism: A borrows misunderstood editorial language to keep a writer from hearing a hurtful rejection, even at cost of a public endorsement.
confusable: D15 protection is not ordinary flattering fraud; B's threatened discouragement must motivate A.
comparison: Signed endorsement differs from managing bakery contact.
seedUse: D15-b accepts a personal cost when B tests reassurance.
